verdict.rationale: Fathom is a meeting-recording and transcription product, so documenting its transcription models, accuracy claims and known limits is a fair question for it. The evidence pack only shows that transcription exists ('Unlimited recordings + transcriptions') and that transcripts can be retrieved via the API and webhooks. None of the cited docs describe the underlying speech-to-text models, accuracy figures, language or speaker-diarization limits, or known failure modes, so there is no evidence this story is delivered.
